blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pain is one of the most common and clinically important symptoms, reflecting disease onset, progression, and treatment response. However, pain is difficult to accurately capture and interpret from medical text, as its expression varies across languages, documentation types, and patient demographics, and is often embedded in terminology, negation, temporality, and contextual descriptions. Existing pain-related studies remain largely monolingual or limited to narrow clinical settings. In this study, we introduce PAINT, a multilingual framework for studying pain representation across medical exams and real-world clinical texts. PAINT includes nine pain-focused dataset partitions spanning English, Spanish, Portuguese, and Japanese, with clinician annotations in all four languages. We curated a structured schema covering pain relevance, pain presence, anatomical location, pain descriptors, and demographic information. To capture multilingual pain representations, we leverage large language models (LLMs) and adopt an ensemble strategy to improve performance. Ten clinicians across four languages validate the labels: the ensemble reaches macro-F1 of 0.91-1.00 on pain relevance and pain presence and 92-100% accuracy on demographics, with inter-annotator $κ$ of 0.82-1.00. We release the WorldMedQA-Pain ensemble labels, the extraction pipeline, validation scripts, and clinician annotation sheets for publicly licensed corpora, providing a foundation for pain-centered clinical NLP and for studying pain documentation across languages and healthcare contexts.
blocks.zh: 疼痛是最常见的临床上最重要的症状之一,反映了疾病的发作、进展和治疗反应。 然而,痛苦很难从医疗文本中准确捕捉和解释,因为其表达因语言、文献类型和病人人口统计而异,而且往往被嵌入术语、否定、时间和背景描述之中。 现有的与疼痛有关的研究基本上仍然是单一语言的或仅限于狭窄的临床环境. 在这项研究中,我们介绍了PAINT,这是一个多语种框架,用于研究通过医学考试和现实世界临床课本的疼痛表现。 PAINT包括9个以疼痛为重点的数据集分区,包括英语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语和日语,所有四种语言都有临床说明。 我们设计了一个结构化的图案 包括疼痛的相关性 疼痛的存在 解剖位置 疼痛描述符 和人口信息 为了捕捉多语种疼痛表现,我们利用大型语言模型(LLMS),并采用综艺策略来提高性能. 4种语言的10名临床医生验证了标签:综艺节目在疼痛相关和疼痛存在方面达到0.91-1.00的宏F1,在人口统计方面达到92%-100%的准确度,广告间费用为0.82-1.00美元。 我们发布了WorldMedQA-Pain 综艺节目标签、提取管道、验证脚本和临床医生注释单,供公开许可的Corcora使用,为以疼痛为中心的临床NLP以及研究不同语言和保健背景的疼痛文献奠定了基础。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Pain is a common and consequential symptom in clinical care, and prior work has shown that its assessment, treatment, and documentation vary with patient race, gender, age, and language ( Singhal et al., 2016 ; Hoffmann and Tarzian, 2001 ; Eccleston et al., 2021 ; Rambachan et al., 2023 ; Lor and Koleck, 2022 ) . Such variation may affect clinical decision making. Studying these differences across languages, document types, and patient demographics is therefore relevant both to clinical practice and to the evaluation of robustness and fairness in large language model (LLM)-based clinical NLP systems.
blocks.zh: 疼痛是临床治疗中常见的并导致的症状,先前的研究表明,其评估、治疗和文献依据患者的种族、性别、年龄和语言而有所不同(Singhal等人,2016年;Hoffmann和Tarzian,2001年;Eccleston等人,2021年;Rambachan等人,2023年;Lor和Koleck,2022年)。 这种变化可能影响临床决策。 因此,研究不同语言、文件类型和病人人口统计的这些差异,既与临床实践相关,也与基于大语言模型(LLM)的临床NLP系统的稳健性和公正性评价相关。

blocks.en: Multilingual clinical NLP primarily relies on two types of resources. Medical licensing examination benchmarks, such as MedQA and WorldMedQA, evaluate structured clinical knowledge in standardized exam settings ( Jin et al., 2021 ; Alonso et al., 2024 ; Matos et al., 2025 ) . Real-world clinical corpora, including MIMIC and BRIDGE, capture how clinicians document patient encounters in routine practice ( Johnson et al., 2016 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . The two offer different views of medical language: one reflects what medicine teaches, the other how medicine is practiced.
blocks.zh: 多语言临床NLP主要依赖两种资源. 医疗许可检验基准,如MedQA和WorldMedQA,评价标准化检验环境下的结构化临床知识(Jin等,2021;Aloonso等,2024;Matos等,2025.). 真实世界临床蝎子,包括MIMIC和BRIDGE,捕捉临床医生如何记录病人在常规练习中的相遇情况(Johnson等,2016;Wu等,2026). 两者对医学语言提出了不同的看法:一是反映医学的教义,一是医学的实践方式.

blocks.en: Despite growing interest in pain-related NLP, available resources remain limited in both linguistic and clinical diversity. A recent systematic review identified small sample sizes, monolingual datasets, and the underrepresentation of non-English populations as persistent challenges in the field ( Rajwal, 2024 ) . Existing annotated pain corpora have similarly focused on English clinical text, including UK mental health records annotated for pain relevance, anatomical location, and pain character ( Chaturvedi et al., 2023 ) , and US clinical notes annotated for chronic pain episodes, causes, locations, severities, and medications ( Carlson et al., 2020 ) . To date, no resource provides a unified multilingual representation of pain across both medical education and clinical practice.
blocks.zh: 尽管对与疼痛有关的NLP的兴趣越来越大,但语言和临床多样性方面的可用资源仍然有限。 最近的一项系统审查确定,抽样规模小、单一语言数据集以及非英语人口代表不足是该领域的持久挑战(Rajwal,2024年)。 已有的注解疼痛蝎子也同样关注了英文临床文本,包括英国的心理健康记录,说明疼痛相关性,解剖位置和疼痛特征(Chaturvedi等,2023年),以及美国临床说明,说明慢性疼痛事件,原因,地点,断裂和药物(Carlson等,2020年). 迄今为止,没有任何资源能够统一多语种地反映医学教育和临床实践中的疼痛。

blocks.en: In this work, we present PAINT, to our knowledge the first multilingual framework for analyzing pain representation across Portuguese, Japanese, Spanish, and English. PAINT is a data resource, and the LLM ensemble serves as its labeling methodology, with open-weight models benchmarked against clinician-annotated labels. We began from a clinical question, how pain is documented and how that documentation changes with language and patient demographics, and selected corpora accordingly. Cross-language corpora with matched documentation purpose for pain are scarce, so we work with the real-world clinical text that is available, in which pain appears incidentally rather than by design. PAINT comprises two resources: WorldMedQA-Pain, containing 2,963 medical licensing examination questions, and BRIDGE-Pain, containing 17,795 real-world clinical records. Pairing exam and clinical text within each language under a common schema, with clinician validation across all four languages, enables within-language comparisons between exam and clinical text. Figure 1 provides an overview of the PAINT framework.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们向大家介绍PAINT,这是第一个分析葡萄牙语、日语、西班牙语和英语中痛苦表现的多语种框架。 PAINT是一个数据资源,LLM综艺是其标签方法,开放量模型以临床医生附加标签为基准。 我们从一个临床问题开始, 疼痛是如何被记录下来的, 以及这些文献是如何随着语言和病人人口的变化而变化的, 并据此选择了公司。 与疼痛相匹配的文献目的的跨语言corpora是稀缺的,因此我们与现有的现实世界临床文本合作,其中疼痛是偶然出现的,而不是通过设计出现的. PAINT包含两种资源:WorldMedQA-Pain,包含2,963个医疗许可检查问题;BRIDGE-Pain,包含17,795个真实世界临床记录. 每种语言的对等考试和临床文本在一个共同的计划中进行,临床医生对所有四种语言进行验证,使考试和临床文本能够进行语言内部的比较。 图1概述了PAINT框架。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三:

blocks.en: (1) Resource. A multilingual pain dataset that pairs medical-licensing-exam text with real clinical notes under one structured schema across four languages, with clinician-validated labels and a released extraction pipeline. The validated labels also serve as an evaluation set for pain extraction, useful for testing clinical NLP systems and LLMs, especially in non-English settings where such data are scarce.
blocks.zh: (1)资源。 一个多语种的疼痛数据集,将医疗许可证 -- -- exam文本与真实的临床笔记结合在一起,在一个结构化的、跨越四种语言的图案下,有临床医生认证的标签和一个释放出取出管。 经验证的标签还用作取出疼痛的一套评价,可用于测试临床NLP系统和LLM,特别是在这类数据稀缺的非英语环境中.

blocks.en: (2) Methodology. A reproducible, clinician-validated labeling pipeline with three methodological strengths: generalizability, a cross-lingual, cross-corpus pain extraction and labeling framework; transferability, the pipeline validated on WorldMedQA-Pain transfers to BRIDGE-Pain, where clinician review confirms macro-F1 of at least 0.91 for pain relevance and pain presence and at least 92% accuracy for demographics across all five clinical corpora; and efficiency, the open-weight ensemble matches GPT-5 on the consensus subset and runs locally on a single GPU, making it usable on controlled-access clinical corpora and in resource-constrained settings.
blocks.zh: (2) 方法。 一个可复制的、经临床鉴定的标签管道,具有三种方法上的优点:通用性、跨语言、跨公司取出疼痛和标签框架;可转让性,在世界MedQA-Pain向BRIDGE-Pain转移时经验证的管道,临床医生审查确认,所有五个临床公司的疼痛相关和疼痛存在情况至少为0.91个宏观F1,而人口结构的准确性至少为92%;效率,开放重量的复合体与共识子集的GPT-5相匹配,并在当地运行在单一的GPU上,使其可用于可控制的临床公司和资源受限环境中。

blocks.en: (3) Documentation. We document the released labels per partition: sample sizes, consensus coverage, pain relevance and presence rates, and demographic field coverage, together with the annotation protocol, clinician instructions, and every inter-annotator disagreement, so that users can judge the reliability of each field and partition before reusing them.
blocks.zh: (3) 文档。 我们记录每个分区释放的标签:样本大小,共识覆盖,疼痛相关性和存在率,以及人口场覆盖,连同注释协议,临床医生指示,以及每一个注释者之间的分歧,这样用户就可以在重用之前判断每个域和分区的可靠性.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent studies suggest that AI systems may reproduce the disparities in pain assessment and treatment documented across race, gender, age, and language ( Singhal et al., 2016 ; Hoffman et al., 2016 ; Hoffmann and Tarzian, 2001 ; Eccleston et al., 2021 ; Rambachan et al., 2023 ) . In knee radiography, radiologist-based severity grading explains only a small share of racial disparities in reported pain, whereas a model trained on patients’ own pain reports explains substantially more of them ( Pierson et al., 2021 ) ; demographic bias has also been observed in LLM-assisted opioid prescribing and pain management ( Omar et al., 2026 ; Omar et al., 2025 ) . Beyond clinical prediction, Berke et al. (2026) propose a computational theory of intuitive pain reasoning, modeling how humans infer and describe pain through mechanisms analogous to intuitive physics and theory of mind.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究显示,人工智能系统可能会复制不同种族、性别、年龄和语言的疼痛评估和治疗方面的差异(Singhal等人,2016年;Hoffman等人,2016年;Hoffmann和Tarzian,2001年;Eccleston等人,2021年;Rambachan等人,2023年)。 在膝盖放射学中,以放射学家为主的重度分级只能解释所报告疼痛中很小一部分的种族差异,而接受过患者自身疼痛报告培训的模型则能解释更多(Pierson等人,2021年);在LLM辅助类阿片处方和疼痛管理中也观察到人口偏差(Omar等人,2026年;Omar等人,2025年)。 除了临床预测外,Berke等(2026年)还提出了直观疼痛推理的计算理论,通过类似于直观物理和心智理论的机制来模拟人类如何推断并描述疼痛.

blocks.en: Examination datasets such as MedQA ( Jin et al., 2021 ) , MedMCQA ( Pal et al., 2022 ) , MedExpQA ( Alonso et al., 2024 ) , and WorldMedQA-V ( Matos et al., 2025 ) evaluate clinical knowledge across one or multiple languages. In parallel, clinical corpora such as MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV ( Johnson et al., 2016 ; Johnson et al., 2023 ) and the ICU databases unified by ricu ( Pollard et al., 2018 ; Faltys et al., 2021 ; Thoral et al., 2021 ; Bennett et al., 2023 ) provide large-scale records of routine clinical documentation. More recently, BRIDGE ( Wu et al., 2026 ) has expanded clinical benchmarking across institutions and languages, and DRAGON ( Bosma and others, 2025 ) across Dutch clinical NLP tasks. However, none of these resources represents pain as a standardized, structured variable suitable for cross-lingual analysis.
blocks.zh: 检查数据集,如MedQA(Jin等,2021年),MedMCQA (Pal等,2022年),MedExpQA(Alonso等,2024年),和WorldMedQA-V(Matos等,2025年)评价一种或多种语言的临床知识. 同时,MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV等临床公司(Johnson等,2016年;Johnson等,2023年)和由ricu统一起来的ICU数据库(Pollard等,2018年;Faltys等,2021年;Thoral等,2021年;Bennett等,2023年)提供了大规模常规临床文献记录. 最近,BRIDGE(Wu等,2026年)扩大了跨机构和语言的临床基准,DRAGON(Bosma等,2025年)则跨越了荷兰临床NLP任务. 然而,这些资源中没有一个是作为适合进行跨语言分析的标准化、结构化变量而带来的痛苦。

blocks.en: Few-shot prompting makes large language models effective clinical information extractors without task-specific fine-tuning ( Agrawal et al., 2022 ) , and chain-of-thought prompting ( Wei et al., 2022 ) and self-consistency decoding ( Wang et al., 2023 ) further improve their reasoning. Ensemble reasoning enhances the stability and consistency of structured clinical extraction ( Chang et al., 2024 ) . PAINT builds on this work by using two multilingual chain-of-thought prompting pipelines and requiring agreement among three models to generate high-precision silver annotations at scale.
blocks.zh: 少发快发能使大型语言模型在不进行任务特有微调的情况下有效获得临床信息提取器(Agrawal等,2022年),再发能连锁快发能(Wei等,2022年)和自相容解码(Wang等,2023年)能进一步改善其推理. 集成推理可增强结构化临床提取的稳定性和一致性(张等,2024. PAINT利用两个多语种思维链来推动管道,并要求三种模式之间达成协议,以产生规模化的高精度银色说明,从而在这项工作的基础上更进一步。

blocks.en: 3 Multilingual Medical Data Collection
blocks.zh: 3 多种语文医疗数据收集

blocks.en: WorldMedQA-Pain is constructed from the text-only national licensing examination partitions assembled by the WorldMedQA team as an extension of WorldMedQA-V ( Matos et al., 2025 ) , retaining four partitions in their original languages. The resulting corpus contains 2,963 instances spanning Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Spanish, and English. The four partitions correspond to REVALIDA (Brazil), the National Medical Licensing Examination (Japan), MIR (Spain), and PLAB (United Kingdom). Each instance carries clinician-annotated labels for pain relevance and pain presence, produced under the multilingual annotation protocol described in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: WorldMedQA-Pain由WorldMedQA团队作为WorldMedQA-V(Matos等,2025年)的延伸组装而成的仅文本国家许可证考试分区,保留了原语言的四个分区. 由此产生的文书包括2 963起巴西葡萄牙文、日文、西班牙文和英文案件。 这四个分区对应的是REVALIDA(巴西)、国家医疗许可考试(日本)、MIR(西班牙)和PLAB(联合王国)。 根据附录一所述多语种注解协议制作的临床医生注解标签。

blocks.en: BRIDGE-Pain is derived from the multilingual BRIDGE benchmark ( Wu et al., 2026 ) and consists of five clinical-text partitions: MEDIQA 2023 Chat-A (English doctor–patient dialogues) ( Abacha et al., 2023 ) , MIMIC-III Outcome (English ICU discharge summaries) ( van Aken et al., 2021 ) , Cantemist (Spanish oncology reports) ( Miranda-Escalada et al., 2020 ) , Brateca (Brazilian Portuguese electronic health records) ( Consoli et al., 2022 ) , and IFMIR (Japanese medication-safety incident reports) ( Wong et al., 2024 ) . We retain the complete MEDIQA and Cantemist partitions and randomly down-sample MIMIC-III, Brateca, and IFMIR to 5,000 records each. The final BRIDGE-Pain corpus contains 17,795 clinical documents, all annotated with the same multilingual ensemble pipeline and validated by clinicians on sampled records.
blocks.zh: BRIDGE-Pain来源于多语种BRIDGE基准(Wu等,2026年),由五个临床文本分区组成: MEDIQA 2023 (英语). Chat-A(英语医生-病人对话) (Abacha等,2023年),MIMIC-III成果(英文ICU出行摘要)(面包车) Aken等,2021年),Cantemist (西班牙肿瘤学报告)(Miranda-Escalada等,2020年),Brateca (巴西葡萄牙电子健康记录)(Consoli等,2022年)和IFMIR (日本药物安全事件报告)(Wong等,2024年). 我们保留了完整的MEDIQA和Cantemist分区,并随机下取MIMIC-III,Brateca和IFMIR的样本,各为5000个记录. 最终的BRIDGE-Painacue包含17,795份临床文件,都附加了相同的多语种综艺节目管道,并由临床医生在抽样记录上验证.

blocks.en: 4 Pain and Demographic Annotation
blocks.zh: 4 疼痛和人口说明

blocks.en: We extract pain and demographic information using two chain-of-thought prompting pipelines ( Wei et al., 2022 ; Kojima et al., 2022 ) , one for pain attributes and one for demographic attributes. All source texts are processed in their original languages. Hierarchical constraints on the pain labels are enforced in the prompt. The complete prompts are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 我们利用两个思维链导管(Wei等,2022;Kojima等,2022)提取疼痛和人口信息,一个用于疼痛属性,一个用于人口属性. 所有原始文本均以原文处理。 对疼痛标签的分级限制在即时执行. 附录D提供了完整的提示。

blocks.en: Each record is described by five fields organized under a hierarchical schema. Pain relevance indicates that the text mentions pain in any way, including a pain term, synonym, or derivative (e.g., painful , painless , or painkiller ), as well as an explicit denial of pain. Pain presence , conditioned on relevance, indicates that pain is asserted to be present in the patient at least once. A record in which the only pain mention is a denial or refers to an attribute of an intervention is therefore relevant but not pain-present. Anatomical location , conditioned on pain presence, records the anatomical site or sites of pain as stated in the text, in concise medical terminology, or unspecified when pain is present but no site is named. Pain descriptors capture free-text descriptions of pain quality. Demographics include age, gender, ethnicity, and occupation when stated in the text. The distinction between relevance and presence is the central design choice of the schema: it separates records that mention pain from those in which pain is actually present, ensuring that denials and intervention-related mentions are not counted as pain. Table 1 gives examples of such mentions in each language.
blocks.zh: 每个记录都由五个领域按照分级计划进行描述。 疼痛相关指文以任何方式提及疼痛,包括疼痛名词,同义词,或衍生词(如疼痛,无痛,或止痛药)等,并明确否认疼痛. 疼痛的出现取决于相关性,表明患者至少存在过一次疼痛。 因此,唯一提到痛苦的是否认或提到干预的属性的记录是相关的,但不是痛苦存在的。 解剖地点以疼痛存在为条件,记录了文本所描述的解剖地点或疼痛地点,简洁的医学术语,或者当疼痛存在但没有命名时未指明的. 疼痛描述符捕捉出自由文字描述疼痛质量. 人口包括年龄、性别、族裔和职业。 关联性与存在性之间的区别是设计方案的核心选择:它将提及疼痛的记录与实际存在疼痛的记录区分开来,确保否认和与干预相关的提及不被算作疼痛. 表1提供了每种语言中提及的例子。

blocks.en: We evaluate five open-weight LLMs on WorldMedQA-Pain using native-language inputs, with GPT-5 ( gpt-5-2025-08-07 ) included as a proprietary reference. As shown in Table 2 , Gemma-4-E4B (4B), Qwen3-8B (8B), and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B (32B) perform best overall, with macro-F1 scores ranging from 0.87 to 0.97 for pain relevance and pain presence across the four partitions. LLaMA-3.1-8B and MedGemma-4B score lower across the partitions and are not included in the ensemble.
blocks.zh: 我们利用当地语言投入,对WorldMedQA-Pain上的5个开放式LLMs进行评估,其中GPT-5(gpt-5-2025-08-07)作为专有参考. 如表2所示,Gemma-4-E4B(4B),Qune3-8B(8B)和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Quen-32B(32B)总体表现最好,宏F1分数从0.87分到0.97分不等,分出四个分区的疼痛相关和疼痛存在. LLaMA-31-8B和MedGemma-4B在分区间得分更低,不计入综艺.

blocks.en: PAINT combines the three highest-performing open-weight models into a consensus ensemble; performance on non-consensus rows is reported in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: PAINT将三种性能最高的开放量级模型合并为一个协商一致的组合;非协商一致行的性能见表3。

blocks.en:
Let y i ( m ) y_{i}^{(m)} denote the prediction of model m ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 } m\in\{1,2,3\} for instance i i , and let ⊥ \bot denote abstention. For the binary tasks of pain relevance and pain presence, we use a strict three-way agreement rule: y ^ i = { y i ( 1 ) , if ​ y i ( 1 ) = y i ( 2 ) = y i ( 3 ) , ⊥ , otherwise . \hat{y}_{i}=\begin{cases}y_{i}^{(1)},&\text{if }y_{i}^{(1)}=y_{i}^{(2)}=y_{i}^{(3)},\\
\bot,&\text{otherwise}.\end{cases} (1) The consensus subset is S = { i : y ^ i ≠ ⊥ } S=\{i:\hat{y}_{i}\neq\bot\} , and ensemble coverage is defined as | S | / N |S|/N , where membership in S S requires agreement on both pain fields. This rule prioritizes precision over recall by restricting downstream analyses to instances on which all three models agree.

For demographic attributes, we use majority voting over non-null predictions, retaining a value when at least two models agree and leaving the field missing when the predictions conflict without a majority. Thus, a value produced by only one model is retained only when no other model provides a conflicting prediction. Anatomical location and pain descriptors are represented as lists and aggregated item by item under the same two-of-three agreement rule. If only one model provides a list, its predictions are retained; otherwise, an item is retained only if at least two models include it. This strategy provides higher coverage for sparse attributes, such as ethnicity and occupation, for which requiring unanimous agreement across all three models would result in substantial data loss.
blocks.zh: 对于人口属性,我们使用多数对非null预测进行投票,在至少两个模型同意时保留一个值,在预测没有多数的情况下,则没有字段。 因此,只有在没有其他模型提供相冲突的预测时,才保留一个模型所产生的数值。 解剖位置和疼痛描述符作为清单和汇总项目,按照相同的"三个协议"规则进行. 如果只有一个模型提供列表,那么它的预测会被保留;否则,只有当至少有两个模型包含时,一个项目才会被保留. 这项战略为诸如族裔和职业等稀少的特征提供了更高的覆盖面,为此,需要在所有三种模式之间达成一致,将导致大量数据损失。

blocks.en: The strict agreement rule sets aside 7–11% of WorldMedQA-Pain rows and up to 31.8% of Brateca. Because WorldMedQA-Pain provides clinician-annotated labels for every row, including abstained rows, we can assess whether the abstain subset is systematically harder than the consensus subset. Table 3 reports macro-F1 for both pain fields on the abstain subset for each individual model, the 2-of-3 majority vote, and GPT-5, with the 0.92–0.99 performance on the consensus subset serving as a reference. Difficulty is concentrated in pain presence: no system exceeds 0.75, and GPT-5 reaches only 0.63–0.73, whereas pain relevance is more recoverable (GPT-5: 0.80–0.98). These results indicate that the disagreements leading to abstention are associated primarily with uncertainty about pain presence rather than pain relevance. Thus, the consensus subset is enriched for cases in which pain presence can be determined more reliably, rather than representing a random sample of the corpus.
blocks.zh: 严格协议规则预留了7-11%的WorldMedQA-Pain行和31.8%的Brateca. 因为WorldMedQA-Pain为每行提供临床医生附加说明的标签,包括弃权行,所以我们可以评估弃权子集是否系统化地比共识子集更难. 表3报告每个个别模式的弃权子集的疼痛场、3分之2的多数票和GPT-5,0.92-0.99协商一致子集的成绩作为参考。 困难集中在疼痛的存在上:没有系统超过0.75;GPT-5只达到0.63-0.73;而疼痛的相关性更能恢复(GPT-5:0.80-0.98)。 这些结果表明,导致弃权的分歧主要与疼痛存在的不确定性有关,而不是与疼痛相关。 因此,对于能够更可靠地确定疼痛存在的情况,共识子集会更加丰富,而不是代表一个随机样本。

Age is represented in years by the first numeric value in the extracted age field; ages under one year are recorded as 0. blocks.en: 5 Clinician Validation
blocks.zh: 5 临床鉴定

blocks.en: The extracted annotations were validated by ten clinicians, two per dataset. For each BRIDGE-Pain dataset, each of its two annotators independently reviewed a random sample of 100 records, and for each WorldMedQA-Pain partition, 30 records.
blocks.zh: 提取的说明由10名临床医生验证,每个数据集2名。 对于每个BRIDGE-Pain数据集,其两个注释员各自独立审查100个记录的随机抽样,对于每个WorldMedQA-Pain分区,30个记录.

blocks.en: For WorldMedQA-Pain, clinician validation covered the demographic attributes of age, gender, and occupation, while pain relevance and pain presence were evaluated against the clinician-annotated labels. For BRIDGE-Pain, clinicians validated pain relevance, pain presence, age, gender, and occupation; anatomical location, pain descriptors, and ethnicity were not validated. To assess inter-annotator reliability, the two annotators assigned to each partition independently annotated an overlapping subset of 50 BRIDGE-Pain records and 10 WorldMedQA-Pain records, without communication or access to each other’s labels. Annotation dates for all annotators are reported in Appendix G .
blocks.zh: 对WorldMedQA-Pain来说,临床医生的鉴定涵盖年龄、性别和职业等人口特征,而疼痛的相关性和疼痛的存在则根据临床医生附加说明的标签进行评估。 对BRIDGE-Pain来说,临床医生验证了疼痛的相关性、疼痛的存在、年龄、性别和职业;解剖地点、疼痛描述和族裔没有得到验证。 为了评估注释者之间的可靠性,为每个分区指派的两位注释者单独附加了50个BRIDGE-Pain记录和10个WorldMedQA-Pain记录的相重叠子集,没有相互通讯或接触对方的标签. 所有注释者的说明日期见附录G。

blocks.en: Metrics are defined under Tasks and metrics below. A blank value confirmed as correctly absent counts as correct, and agreement between clinicians requires an exact match of normalised values, with two blanks counted as a match. Percentage agreement is used for demographic fields because high-cardinality or single-category samples can make κ \kappa unstable or undefined; demographic κ \kappa values and the matching rules are given in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 以下任务和衡量标准下对计量进行了界定。 一个空白值被确认为正确缺失的计数是正确的,临床医生之间的协议要求精确匹配正态值,两个空白被计算为匹配. 百分比协议用于人口领域,因为高心率或单类样本会使 $\kappa 变得不稳定或未定义;人口 $\kappa 值和相配规则载于附录 E.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 5 , the ensemble achieves macro-F1 scores of 0.91–1.00 on BRIDGE-Pain, comparable to its 0.92–0.99 performance on WorldMedQA-Pain. Demographic extraction reaches 92–100% accuracy across all five clinical datasets. Inter-annotator agreement is similarly high, with κ = 0.88 \kappa=0.88 –1.00 for pain relevance, κ = 0.87 \kappa=0.87 –1.00 for pain presence, and 90–100% agreement for demographic attributes across the BRIDGE-Pain and WorldMedQA-Pain overlaps. Wherever defined, demographic κ \kappa values range from 0.82 to 1.00, corresponding to almost-perfect agreement under the Landis and Koch (1977) scale. Detailed per-field results, confusion matrices, and all observed disagreements are provided in Appendix E .

blocks.en: 6 Availability and Dataset Statistics
blocks.zh: 6 可用性和数据集统计

blocks.en: We release the extraction pipeline, prompts, schema, validation and agreement scripts, WorldMedQA-Pain labels, and clinician annotation sheets (source text removed) for the publicly licensed corpora; sheets for credentialed corpora are provided on request. The released consensus labels cover pain relevance and pain presence; anatomical location, pain descriptors, and demographic fields are provided as per-model raw outputs and can be aggregated with the released scripts. The clinician gold labels for WorldMedQA-Pain will be made available in a subsequent version. BRIDGE-Pain cannot be redistributed under the underlying corpus licenses, but users with access can regenerate the labels using the released pipeline. Every number in Tables 5 , 10 , 11 and 13 reproduces from the sheets with the released scripts, as documented in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 我们为公开许可的Corpora发布提取管道、提示、计划、验证和协议脚本、WorldMedQA-Pain标签和临床医生注释表(删除来源文本);应要求提供证明Corpora的表格。 所发布的共识标签涵盖了疼痛的相关性和疼痛的存在;解剖位置,疼痛描述符,以及人口学领域作为模型原始产出提供,可以与所发布的脚本相加. WorldMedQA-Pain的临床金色标签将在随后的版本提供. BRIDGE-Pain不能根据基本授权许可证进行再分配,但有访问权的用户可以使用释放的管道重新生成标签。 如附录E所记载,表5、表10、表11和表13中的每个数字都取自已发行的脚本。

blocks.en: Tables 6 and 7 summarise the released labels per partition. The label distributions differ substantially between partitions and are not comparable prevalence estimates.
blocks.zh: 表6和表7汇总了每个分区释放的标签。 标签分布在分区之间差别很大,不是可比的流行率估计.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced PAINT, to our knowledge the first multilingual resource for pain representation across medical licensing examinations and real-world clinical text in English, Spanish, Portuguese, and Japanese. It contributes clinician-validated pain and demographic annotations and the open-weight labeling pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了PAINT, 据我们所知,这是第一个多语种资源,用于在医疗许可证检查和真实世界临床文本中以英语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语和日语表达疼痛。 它提供经临床鉴定的疼痛和人口说明以及开放式标签管道。

blocks.en: PAINT is intended as a benchmark for multilingual clinical information extraction and as infrastructure for studying how pain documentation, and the demographic detail attached to it, varies across languages and care settings, including whether large language models reproduce known disparities in pain assessment. The pipeline extends to further languages and document types with minimal adaptation.
blocks.zh: PAINT旨在作为多语种临床信息提取的基准,作为研究疼痛文献及其所附人口细节的基础设施,语言和护理环境各不相同,包括大型语言模型是否复制了已知的疼痛评估差异. 管道扩展至其他语言和文件类型,适应程度最低。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Corpus purpose, language, country, and healthcare system co-vary across the nine partitions, so the label distributions in Table 6 characterise each corpus rather than estimate prevalence. Differences between partitions should be read as corpus-purpose effects rather than as cultural claims about pain experience.
blocks.zh: 公司的目的,语言,国家,以及医疗系统 跨越9个分区, 所以表6中的标签分布 字符化每个主体,而不是估计流行率。 分区之间的区别应理解为实体作用,而不是关于痛苦经历的文化主张。

blocks.en: PAINT captures pain as documented by clinicians and examination writers, not as reported by patients; none of the source corpora carry numeric pain scores. The schema is designed to accommodate structured pain-intensity scores and patient-reported pain once corpora with such data become available.
blocks.zh: PAINT捕捉到临床医生和检查写作者所记录的疼痛,而不是病人所报道的;来源的Corpora都没有携带数位疼痛分数. 该计划旨在适应结构化疼痛分数以及一旦获得此类数据后患者报告的疼痛.

blocks.en: The five BRIDGE-Pain partitions cannot be redistributed, so the clinical half of the resource must be regenerated by users with access to the source data, using the released pipeline.
blocks.zh: 5个BRIDGE-Pain分区无法被再分配,因此临床资源的一半必须被能够访问源数据的用户再生出,使用所释放的管道.

blocks.en: Unlike the Spanish and Japanese partitions, the English partitions are not country-matched: WorldMedQA-Pain uses the UK PLAB examination, whereas BRIDGE-Pain contains US clinical corpora (MEDIQA and MIMIC-III), so exam-versus-clinical differences in English are confounded with British versus American clinical language. Also, both Portuguese partitions are Brazilian, so European Portuguese pain vocabulary is not represented.
blocks.zh: 与西班牙和日本分治不同,英语分治没有国别比对:WorldMedQA-Pain使用英国的PLAB检查,而BRIDGE-Pain包含美国临床蝎子(MEDIQA和MIMIC-III),因此英语的考试-与临床差异与英国的临床语言相混淆. 另外,两个葡萄牙分法都是巴西分法,因此欧洲葡语疼痛词汇没有体现.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: PAINT combines public medical licensing examinations with multilingual clinical corpora. WorldMedQA contains no patient-identifiable information, and the pain annotation study was granted IRB exemption by MIT. The annotation effort was conducted by ten clinicians (nine physicians and one pharmacist), all fluent in the source languages and listed as co-authors. Annotation procedures and timelines are documented in Appendix G .
blocks.zh: PAINT将公共医疗许可检查与多语种临床公司合并. WorldMedQA没有包含可识别患者的信息,疼痛注释研究被麻省理工学院授予IRB豁免. 注释工作由10名临床医生(9名医生和1名药剂师)进行,他们都流利地使用源语言,并被列为共同作者。 说明程序和时间表载于附录G。

blocks.en: The five BRIDGE-Pain corpora are used in accordance with their original licensing and ethical frameworks, including the PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License for MIMIC-III. PAINT does not redistribute source clinical text. Clinician annotation sheets are released with all source text removed for corpora whose licenses permit it (WorldMedQA, Cantemist, IFMIR); for the remaining corpora (MIMIC-III, MEDIQA, Brateca) they are provided on request to users with access to the underlying corpus.
blocks.zh: 五个BRIDGE-Pain公司按照最初的许可证和道德框架使用,包括MIMIC-III的PhysioNet认证健康数据许可证。 PAINT不重新分配源临床文本. 临床笔记表公布时,所有来源文字均被取出给其许可证许可的公司(WorldMedQA、Cantemist、IFMIR);其余公司(MIMIC-III、MEDIQA、Brateca)则应要求向用户提供这些笔记。

blocks.en: PAINT is designed to support multilingual clinical NLP research, information extraction, and fairness auditing. It is not intended for clinical diagnosis, treatment recommendation, or automated triage. Because demographic attributes may be sensitive, demographic results for restricted clinical datasets are reported as aggregate statistics; the only record-level values shown are the seventeen annotation disagreements in Appendix E , which carry no identifiers.
blocks.zh: PAINT旨在支持多语言临床NLP研究,信息提取和公平审计. 它不是为了临床诊断、治疗建议或自动分解。 由于人口属性可能很敏感,限制的临床数据集的人口结果被报告为汇总统计;所显示的唯一记录级值是附录E中的17个注释差异,其中没有标识符.

blocks.en: Appendix A Compute and infrastructure
blocks.zh: 附录A 计算和基础设施

blocks.en: PAINT uses inference only, no model is trained or fine-tuned. The ensemble runs three open-weight models — Gemma-4-E4B (4B), Qwen3-8B (8B), and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B (32B) — under 4-bit quantization, with GPT-5 (gpt-5-2025-08-07) included as a proprietary reference accessed through the OpenAI API. Open-weight inference was run on a single NVIDIA A100 (40 GB) or L4 (24 GB) GPU, with 4-bit NF4 quantization via bitsandbytes. GPT-5 was queried via API and used no local compute.

Accuracy in panel (a) of Table 5 is the fraction of
records on which the clinician marked the ensemble value correct. The
judgement is the clinician’s, not a string comparison: following the
instructions in Appendix F , a blank ensemble value
is marked correct when the text states no such information, and an
occupation is marked correct when it names the occupation stated in
the text, so wording variants such as “nurse” and “registered
nurse” are not penalised. Percentage agreement in panel (b) compares
the two clinicians’ final labels, each reconstructed as the ensemble
value when marked correct and as the supplied correction otherwise.
Labels are normalised before comparison: blank and null-equivalent
cells map to a single missing value, age to its first integer, and
gender to male or female ; occupation is compared as an
exact string after lower-casing and whitespace trimming, so “nurse”
and “registered nurse” count as a disagreement here. Two missing
values count as agreement. Records on which either clinician left the
field unjudged are excluded from the agreement denominator.

This appendix documents the protocol used to produce the clinician
gold pain labels for WorldMedQA-Pain.
The protocol was developed once and instantiated per language; the per-language lexicons are listed in Table 16 .

blocks.en:
Each exam item is annotated on its
native-language question text in two ordered steps, mirroring the
hierarchical pain schema: 1. pain-relevance. Mark Yes if any
pain-related concept appears anywhere in the item (a pain term,
a synonym, or a morphological derivative such as
“painful”, “painless”, or “painkiller”),
including explicit denial; otherwise No . 2. pain-presence. For pain-relevance = Yes {=}\textsf{Yes} items, mark Yes if pain is asserted in
the patient at least once in the description; mark No if pain appears only as a denial or only as an
attribute of an intervention (“painless”,
“painkiller”). Items that did not resolve cleanly under this procedure were highlighted
and adjudicated by the team rather than decided unilaterally.
